note: The build guide as data. docs/BUILD_GUIDE.md explains the method; the four cards under docs/playbooks/ are the working playbooks. BUILD_RULES manifests preserve ids and ownership; selected exact phrases and named-check existence are also checked. This does not prove complete semantic preservation or full enforcement of every statement. enforcement names the available mechanism; coverage_scope and remaining_gap qualify partial controls. BK-80 owns the evidence-integrity follow-up. Apply requirements proportionately to the registered claim without waiving existing acceptance or mandatory release gates.

rules.statement: A fix starts with measured reproduction, a causal defect family and invariant, a graph-first source-verified impact inventory, and predeclared transfer, boundary and unrelated-behaviour witnesses. Hypotheses and unenumerated sites are not established scope.
rules.must_contain: A causal fix contract precedes implementation.
rules.coverage_scope: Manifest and exact anchor checks preserve this declared stage obligation; a named technical reviewer examines the actual reproduction, causal evidence, population and proof design.
rules.remaining_gap: No lint establishes root cause or completeness of the impact inventory. Future product fixes require their own recorded evidence; those unexecuted obligations remain NOT_RUN. Substantive legal meaning also requires qualified counsel review.

rules.statement: Generalise the mechanism, not distinct legal rules. Refuse incident-name, phrase, scenario-id or remembered-answer branches; preserve deterministic safeguards and source-backed jurisdiction/time-specific rule data through explicit applicability, identity, provenance and invalidation. Code, prompts, configuration, data and models follow the same fix discipline.
rules.must_contain: Generalise the mechanism, not distinct legal rules.
rules.coverage_scope: Manifest and exact anchor checks preserve the obligation; technical review must inspect the changed mechanism, legitimate discrimination and removal of subsumed point guards.
rules.remaining_gap: A textual check cannot distinguish a sound abstraction from a disguised incident patch or over-broad legal rule. Future implementation and legal applicability evidence remain NOT_RUN until executed.

rules.statement: A fixed incident is not transfer proof. Retain the original witness, exercise distinct or held-out contexts and meaning-preserving transformations, test conditions that must change or remain refused, and measure unrelated behaviours plus cumulative regressions against coherent before/after source and input identities without weakening the contract to obtain green.
rules.must_contain: A fixed incident is not transfer proof.
rules.coverage_scope: Manifest and exact anchor checks preserve the evidence requirement. Review examines executed populations, denominators, intended negative-control failures, unaffected-behaviour witnesses and applicable specialist evidence.
rules.remaining_gap: No general linter proves that every future fix transfers or has no collateral effect. Each fix needs executed semantic and integration evidence; approved model, browser or counsel work cannot be replaced by Class-A structure checks. Unrun evidence remains NOT_RUN.

rules.statement: Accept only the demonstrated defect family and tested population, with independent technical review, qualified legal review where applicable, coherent identities, explicit exclusions, remaining risks and recurrence ownership. Never claim universal future-proofing or infer semantic approval from keyword lint.
rules.must_contain: Accept the demonstrated scope, never universal future-proofing.
rules.coverage_scope: Manifest and exact anchor checks preserve the sign-off requirement; a reviewer other than the implementer evaluates the linked evidence and the limits of the exact claim.
rules.remaining_gap: Review-field presence is not reviewer identity, authority or actual semantic acceptance. Future fix-specific evidence and approvals remain NOT_RUN until obtained; BK-80 owns broader evidence-integrity controls.
